sh_6k.interpretation: Geometry that recovers the regex grouping *without parsing* is what licenses applying H-Nav to CrossEp-Know, where no templates and no serial numbers exist. High F1 -> the detector is validated. Low F1 -> any downstream gain is attributable to the metadata, not to geometry, and must be reported as such.
